records.hold_reason: Electoral colleges are a mechanism of indirect election, so options C and E overlap. The question does not distinguish the selecting body from the electoral method.

original_record.question: Which of the following ethnic groups was the pre-colonial political structure Not influenced by the Islamic culture?

records.source_excerpt:
26: Which of the following ethnic groups was the pre-colonial political structure Not influenced by the
Islamic culture?
A. Kanuri B. Nupe C. Tiv D. Fulani
records.hold_reason: The categorical absence of Islamic influence is broader than the institutional distinction probably intended. A source defining the pre-colonial political structures and period is needed.
